name: Lovászpatona (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lovászpatona: a crowned quartered red and blue shield with a horse, a sabre, a sheaf of grain and a church, above a red scroll inscribed LOVÁSZPATONA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lovászpatona arms with crown and scroll
